title: JoySpace Epistemic Receipt v0.1
description: Machine-readable schema for a JoySpace / Wisdom Games epistemic receipt. Authority remains false. This artifact records a sequence of epistemic moves; it does not create truth, authority, legal findings, or participation status.

receipt_id.description: Unique identifier for this receipt. Recommended format: er_{hash16} or similar deterministic id.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of receipt sealing.

identity_label.description: Optional identity label (e.g. jaywisdom.base.eth). Typed as label only. Never authority or state role.

quest_family.description: Optional quest family from the Alabama Edition or equivalent.

moves.description: Ordered sequence of epistemic moves performed.

classifications.description: Classifications applied to sources or claims.

dissent_notes.description: Preserved alternative readings or counter-evidence. Empty array is valid.

result_state.description: Terminal CrissCross state. Descriptive only; never a legal finding.

replay_instructions.description: Optional human- or machine-readable instructions for replaying the sequence.

authority.description: Hard constraint. Must always be false.

scoring.description: Optional scoring summary. Points never equal truth.

detail.description: Optional free-text detail for this move.

pointer.description: URL, path, or other public locator.
